title: The Great Scallop
subject: scallop

details.name: Hinge
details.note: The oldest part of the shell, where its growth began.

details.name: Growth Lines
details.note: One ring for every season of slow growth.

caption: Hold a real shell at the Discovery Table

lines.text: Every shell begins here, at the hinge, and grows outward from it.
Each fine ring marks a season, so a shell keeps its own diary.
Some live for more than twenty years, and the rings count them all.
lines.asr: Some live for more than 20 years and the rings count them all
